info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Active Customer Aggregation API
info.description: The Active Customer Aggregation API serves as a powerful tool for businesses to identify and manage active customers within their ecosystem. This endpoint allows you to aggregate data related to customers who are currently engaged or have shown recent activity, providing valuable insights for targeted marketing and customer retention strategies. Typical consumers include marketing teams and customer relationship managers who leverage this information to tailor their outreach efforts. By analyzing active customer behaviors, businesses can optimize their engagement strategies and improve overall service delivery.
